title: General-purpose models keep their native behavior
summary:
Native model behavior and intact vision requests meet a growing community app catalog.

Removed the default conversational system prompt from more than 20 general-purpose text models. Requests without a user-supplied system message now follow each model’s native behavior; specialized models keep their tailored prompts.

Message normalization now preserves image-bearing content arrays instead of turning them into "[object Object]". Tool schemas sent to Vertex AI also retain supported fields while dropping incompatible schema keywords, reducing tool-call failures.

Thirteen apps joined the catalog, including study and math tools, multilingual video dubbing, Persian-language chat, a Discord bot, and a prompt-based media creator. The additions span Learn, chat, games, image, and video/audio categories.
